target: forge.sh pr-state — a pr: URL whose scheme/host/port differ from the configured instance makes no request (control: the matching URL does)
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
P="/api/v4/projects/grp%2Fsub%2Fproj/merge_requests/7"
U=https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj/-/merge_requests/7
fx_http "GET $P" 200 '{"state":"merged"}'
t() { fx_run pr-state "$2"; echo "$1=$FX_OUT rc=$FX_RC"; }
t foreign https://evil.example.test/grp/sub/proj/-/merge_requests/7
t otherport https://gitlab.example.test:9999/grp/sub/proj/-/merge_requests/7
t subdomain https://ci.gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj/-/merge_requests/7
echo "requests_before=$(fx_nreq)"
t control "$U"
echo "requests_after=$(fx_nreq)"; fx_reqs
fx_done
